newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine economic zones' exports exceeds target.
newsitem.headline: Philippine economic zones' exports exceeds target.

text.p: Export sales of companies located in the Philippines' economic zones reached $5.134 billion in the first ten months of the year, exceeding the full-year target of $5 billion, Philippine Economic Zone Authority director general Lilia de Lima said on Thursday.
Export receipts totalled $3.504 billion in the same ten-month period last year.
Leading the economic zones was the export processing zone in the northern Baguio city which sold $1.014 billion of manufactured goods abroad, data released by de Lima showed.
The Cavite export processing zone, just south of Manila, was second with export receipts reaching $926 million during the same period.
Companies located in the four economic zones in the country and over 10 special industrial zones are eligible for tax and tariff incentives.
